messages:
nina: saw a spike in mixed-dim batches causing excessive splits and higher token bill. thinking about a preflight sampling + priority hint to reduce work.
andre: agree. small items should be fastpath. propose client can send X-Embed-Priority per item and we auto-promote items <1KB.
lucy: we should also add a preflight sample which returns an estimated bill and a suggested split plan. header: X-Embed-Preflight: plan_id.
frank: runtime note: preflight must be cheap (<5ms) and avoid parsing full vectors. require SDK to submit dims and bytes when possible.
ops-bot: metric request: preflight_requests, preflight_apply_rate, oversize_413_count, priority_hit_rate.
nina: quota semantics: provisional_charge while plan applied then reconcile on compute. show estimated cost in console but don't bill until compute completes.
lucy: console: add "simulate" button that runs preflight on sample payloads and shows cost delta if user applies suggested splits.
andre: security: TTL for plan_id short (30s) and don't store payloads.
frank: rollout: feature flag embed.preflight.v1 = telemetry-only -> advisory -> opt-in apply. start with 2% of tenants.
nina: action items: SDK helper (lucy), cheap preflight path (frank), console sim + telemetry (console-team). I'll open RFC.
console-team: noted, will add dashboard tiles for estimated_savings and provisional_charge_rollbacks.
